text.formatted: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.
text.plain: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

gaps.name: The spell also targets objects. The cursed-magic-item exception retains the item’s curse and breaks its owner’s attunement, but the schema has no operation that links the targeted item to its owner while keeping that item curse.
